semiconductor_relevance: High — Shenzhen Gorgeous Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor equipment and consumables, providing technical support services critical to the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Shenzhen Gorgeous Technology Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor equipment market, established in 2012 and headquartered in Shenzhen. The company offers a range of semiconductor equipment and consumables while providing technical support services, maintaining strong relationships with international enterprises.

regional_presence.China: The company has 6 sales outlets across East China, South China, and North China, covering all central cities in the country.
